items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: It wasn't Jap Allen. George Lee? Clarence Love? Andy Kirk? Bennie Moten? Blue Devils?

ctx.x: It's in Ross Russell's book about Charlie Parker. I can't remember which band it was. There was one incident like that.
I don't know. It's the first of me hearing. It wasn't Jap Allen. George Lee? Clarence Love? Andy Kirk? Bennie Moten? Blue Devils?
No, it wasn't any of those. [JESSE PRICE]
